composition_variation: Create a plush watercolor illustration centered on Shiro, the small white dog from Crayon Shin-chan, resting with his front paws together on one mossy garden step. Preserve his familiar fluffy cloudlike outline, tiny dark eyes, black nose, and curved ears. His head tilts gently toward a single daisy, conveying friendly curiosity. Use pale sage, butter yellow, and powder blue, with soft rounded shrubs, a few delicate petals near the bottom, and luminous quiet morning air. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
